# Arktek3D

> > Arktek3D delivers photorealistic 3D architectural rendering and CGI visualization services for residential, commercial, and specialized design projects.

Founded by Ted Afetian and led by a team including Brett Allen, Sarosh Ahmed, Jose Mascorro, and others, Arktek3D (also known as Arktek Studio) specializes in architectural visualization, exterior and interior rendering, and real estate marketing materials with a strong presence in Los Angeles and Houston markets.

## Key Topics

- Architectural Visualization
- 3D Rendering Services
- Photorealistic Rendering
- CGI Services
- Exterior Rendering
- Interior Rendering
- 3D Modeling
- Real Estate Marketing
- Residential Rendering
- Home Design Visualization
- Architectural Design
- Los Angeles Market
- Design Visualization
- Commercial Rendering

- [3d rendering home design | House 3D Rendering Services](https://arktek3d.com/3d-home-design-rendering-services): Residential home design 3D rendering services by Arktek Studio
- [3D Architectural Rendering Services in Los Angeles](https://arktek3d.com/3d-rendering-services-in-los-angeles): Arktek3D's architectural rendering services in Los Angeles market
- [3D Library Rendering Services | Arktek 3D Studio](https://arktek3d.com/3d-library-rendering-services): Specialized library design visualization and 3D rendering services
